test_handle_resume_command: test the GatewayRunner._handle_resume_command handler for the /resume slash command
test_resume_by_name: test resuming a named session by passing its title to the /resume command
test_list_named_sessions: test listing titled sessions when /resume is called with no arguments
test_resume_auto_lineage: test that /resume resolves to the latest session in a title lineage
test_resume_flushes_memories: test that switching sessions flushes memories from the current session
